translation: shuroo Allah kay naam say jo sabb per meharban hai , boht meharban hai
jab woh honey wala waqiaa paish aajaye ga ,
to uss kay paish aaney ko koi jhutlaney wala nahi hoga ,
woh aik teh o baala kernay wali cheez hogi ,
jab zameen aik bhonchal say jhanjorr di jaye gi ,
aur paharon ko pees ker choora kerdiya jaye ga
yahan tak kay woh bikhra huwa ghubar ban ker reh jayen gay ,
aur ( logo ! ) tum teen qismon mein butt jao gay .
chunacheh jo dayen haath walay hain , kiya kehna unn dayen haath walon ka !
aur jo bayen haath walay hain , kiya batayen woh bayen haath walay kiya hain-?
aur jo sabqat ley janey walay hain , woh to hain hi sabqat ley janey walay !
wohi hain jo Allah kay khaas muqarrab banday hain ,
woh naimaton kay baaghaat mein hon gay ,
. shuroo kay logon  mein say boht say ,
aur baad kay logon  mein say thoray
soney kay taaron say bani hoi oonchi nishiston per
aik doosray kay samney unn per takiya lagaye huye !
sada rehney walay larkay unn kay samney gardish mein hon gay ,
aesi sharab kay piyalay , jug aur jaam ley ker
jiss say naa unn kay sar mein dard hoga , aur naa unn kay hosh uren gay ,
aur woh phal ley ker jo woh pasand keren ,
aur parindon ka woh gosht ley ker jiss ko unn ka dil chahye !
aur woh bari bari aankhon wali hooren !
aesi jaisay chupa ker rakhay huye moti !
yeh sabb badla hoga unn kamon ka jo woh kiya kertay thay .
woh uss jannat mein naa koi beyhooda baat sunen gay , aur naa koi gunah ki baat ,
haan jo baat hogi , salamti hi salamti ki hogi .
aur woh jo dayen haath walay hon gay , kiya kehna unn dayen haath walon ka !
. ( woh aesh keren gay ) kaantton say pak bairiyon mein !
aur oopper talay laday huye kelay kay darakhton mein ,
aur door tak phelay huye saye mein ,
aur behtay huye paani mein ,
aur dher saray phalon mein
jo naa kabhi khatam hon gay , aur naa unn per koi rok tok hogi ,
aur oonchay rakhay huye farshon mein .
yaqeen jano , hum ney unn aurton ko naee uthaan di hai ,
chunacheh unhen kanwariyan banaya hai ,
. ( shohron kay liye ) mohabbat say bhari hoi , umar mein barabar !
sabb kuch dayen haath walon kay liye ,
. ( jinn mein say ) boht say shuroo kay logon  mein say hon gay ,
aur boht say baad walon mein say .
aur jo bayen haath walay hain , kiya batayen bayen haath walay kiya hain-?
woh hon gay tapti hoi lo mein , aur kholtay huye paani mein ,
aur siyah dhuyen kay saye mein ,
jo naa thanda hoga , naa koi faeeda phonchaney wala .
yeh log iss say pehlay baray aesh mein thay ,
aur baray bhari gunah per array rehtay thay
aur kaha kertay thay kay :  kiya jab hum mar-jayen gay , aur mitti aur haddiyan ban ker reh jayen gay , to kiya hamen dobara zinda kiya jaye ga-?
aur kiya humaray pehlay guzray huye baap dadon ko bhi-?
keh do kay :  yaqeenan sabb aglay aur pichlay log
aik mutayyan din kay tey shuda waqt per zaroor ikatthay kiye jayen gay ,
phir aey jhutlaney walay gumraho ! tum logon  ko
aik aesay darkht mein say khana parray ga jiss ka naam zaqoom hai ,
phir ussi say pet bharney hon gay ,
phir uss kay oopper say kholta huwa paani peena parray ga ,
aur peena bhi iss tarah jaisay piyas ki beemari walay oont peetay hain .
yeh hogi jaza o saza kay din unn logon  ki mehmani !
hum ney tumhen peda kiya hai , phir tum tasdeeq kiyon nahi kertay-?
zara yeh batlao kay jo nutfa tum tapkatay ho ,
kiya ussay tum peda kertay ho ya peda kernay walay hum hain-?
hum ney hi tumharay darmiyan moat kay faislay ker rakhay hain , aur koi nahi hai jo hamen iss baat say aajiz ker-sakay
kay hum tumhari jagah tum jaisay aur log ley ayen , aur tumhen phir say kissi aesi halat mein peda kerden jissay tum nahi jantay .
aur tumhen apni pehli pedaeesh ka poora pata hai , phir kiyon sabaq nahi letay-?
acha yeh batao kay jo kuch tum zameen mein botay ho ,
kiya ussay tum ugatay ho , ya uganey walay hum hain-?
agar hum chahen to ussay choora choora ker daalen , jiss per tum bhonchkay reh jao
kay hum per to tawaan parr-gaya ,
balkay hum hain hi badd naseeb !
acha yeh batao kay yeh paani jo tum peetay ho ,
kiya ussay badalon say tum ney utaara hai , ya utaarney walay hum hain-?
agar hum chahen to ussay karrwa bana ker rakh den , phir tum kiyon shukar ada nahi kertay-?
acha yeh batao kay yeh aag jo tum sulgatay ho ,
kiya uss ka darkht tum ney peda kiya hai ,   ya peda kernay walay hum hain-?
hum ney hi uss ko naseehat ka saman aur sehrai musfiron kay liye faeeday ki cheez banaya hai .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum apney azeem perwerdigar ka naam ley ker uss ki tasbeeh kero .
abb mein unn jagahon ki qasam kha ker kehta hun jahan sitaray girtay hain ,
. aur agar tum samjho to yeh bari zabardast qasam hai
kay yeh bara ba-waqar Quran hai
jo aik mehfooz kitab mein ( pehlay say ) darj hai ,
iss ko wohi log chootay hain jo khoob pak hain ,
yeh tamam jahano kay perwerdigar ki taraf say thora thora ker kay utaara jaraha hai .
kiya phir bhi tum iss kalam say bey perwai barattay ho-?
aur tum ney issi ko apna rozgar bana liya hai kay ( iss ko ) jhutlatay raho-?
phir aisa kiyon nahi hota hai kay jab ( kissi ki ) jaan galay tak phonch jati hai ,
aur uss waqt tum ( hasrat say uss ko ) dekh rahey hotay ho ,
. aur tum say ziyada hum uss kay qareeb hotay hain , magar tumhen nazar nahi aata
agar tumhara hisab kitab honey wala nahi hai to aisa kiyon nahi hota
kay tum uss jaan ko wapis ley aao , agar tum sachay ho-?
phir agar woh ( marney wala ) Allah kay muqarrab bandon mein say ho
to ( uss kay liye ) aaram hi aaram hai , khushboo hi khushboo hai , aur naimaton say bhara baagh hai .
aur agar woh dayen haath walon mein say ho
to ( uss say kaha jaye ga kay : )  tumharay liye salamti hi salamti hai kay tum dayen haath walon mein say ho .
aur agar woh unn gumrahon mein say ho jo haq ko jhutlaney walay thay
to ( uss kay liye ) kholtay huye paani ki mehmani hai ,
aur dozakh ka dakhila hai !
uss mein koi shak nahi kay bilkul sahih maani mein yehi yaqeeni baat hai .
lehaza ( aey payghumber ! ) tum apney azeem perwerdigar ka naam ley ker uss ki tasbeeh kero .
